requirements.requirement: Herb planter of three cells side by side
requirements.evidence: Three full cells in a straight row: piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full (507mm x 384mm footprint), locked with jointBolts and capped.

requirements.requirement: Each cell with a bin that drains
requirements.evidence: One hex-bin-full-drain in each cell: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain — all with drainage holes, each filled with soil and planted (basil-young, mint-young, parsley-young).

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell linear planter (-1,0,0 to 1,0,0) with a full-depth drained bin in every cell, filled with soil and planted with three herbs for staging. Caps and joint locks applied; build is verified clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your herb planter is on the way — I'll set up three side-by-side draining bins for you.
